title: Parcel delivery rider killed in collision with dump truck in Dumanjug
summary: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A parcel delivery rider died after his motorcycle collided head-on with a dump truck in Sitio Ecotech, Barangay Liong, Dumanjug, Cebu, on Wednesday morning, October 14.…

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A parcel delivery rider died after his motorcycle collided head-on with a dump truck in Sitio Ecotech, Barangay Liong, Dumanjug, Cebu, on Wednesday morning, October 14. Police identified the victim as alias “Jeff,” of legal age and a resident of Barangay Lawaan in Dumanjug. He was driving a black Honda Beat motorcycle. Based on an initial investigation by the Dumanjug Municipal Police Station, the incident occurred at 9:45 a.m. Both vehicles were traveling in opposite directions.
